english.title: London hackney carriage proprietor neglect to require, retain or produce licence of driver
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a London hackney carriage proprietor,

(A)_[neglected to require to be delivered to you the licence of a driver, namely **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), during such period as that driver remained]_
(B)_[neglected to retain in your possession the licence of a driver, namely **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), during such period as that driver remained]_
(C)_[refused or neglected to produce the licence of a driver, namely **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..) when summoned to produce that driver before a justice of the peace, having received the summons when he was]_
(D)_[refused or neglected to produce the licence of a driver, namely **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..) when summoned to produce that driver before a justice of the peace, having received the summons when she was]_

in your service
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21 of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843.
